metrics.full_operating_result: R_net + S_recognisable - C_variable - C_incremental_fixed - C_aircraft_use - D_and_A_owned_or_capex - C_startup_expense - C_exit_expense
metrics.project_cash_pre_financing_pre_interest_: customer_cash + support_cash + operating_rebates - gross_operating_cash - capex_cash - advances_cash - deposits_cash + returned_deposits + disposal_cash
metrics.funding_before_financing: max(0,-min(cumsum(project_cash_before_financing))) at actual event dates, including pre-launch and wind-down; not annual loss
metrics.financing_cash: equity_cash + debt_draws - debt_principal_repayments - financing_only_fees; interest is already in project_cash_before_financing, do not repeat
metrics.incremental_cash: cash_project - cash_KEEP; enterprise total and incremental project funding separately labelled
metrics.operating_to_cash_bridge: Operating_result + D&A + noncash_MRO_reserve_expense - actual_MRO_cash_excluded_from_P&L - delta_receivables - delta_inventory - delta_advances - delta_deposits + delta_payables + delta_customer_advances - capex_cash + disposal_cash - interest_cash - tax_cash; reconcile to direct event ledger
metrics.reserve_treatment: If PBH reserve is actually remitted monthly, that payment is cash and must not be added back as noncash. Later maintenance invoice net of reserve setoff/refunds. If accounting reserve only: add back then cash at event.

aircraft_cost_basis.cash_operating_lease: Lease/use charge in operating result; contractual rental cash in cash ledger; purchase capex and owned depreciation absent for same contract
aircraft_cost_basis.owned: Depreciation, insurance, maintenance and crew in operating result; purchase/advance in investing cash; principal financing separate
aircraft_cost_basis.capitalised_lease: Explicit management/accounting mapping: right-of-use depreciation/use cost, interest separate; liability principal cash; never full rent plus depreciation
aircraft_cost_basis.existing_aircraft: Committed common lease/crew remain in both KEEP and project; not cancelled merely because flight cancelled. Show total commitments and avoidable delta.
aircraft_cost_basis.new_aircraft: No lost historical donor necessarily; availability/acceptance/induction and alternative use jointly evaluated
aircraft_cost_basis.reserve: One physical reserve with dated assignment; cost charged once including idle calendar commitments; availability is not price

double_count_guards: One journey fare once; each flown leg consumes seat and incurs physical flight cost.
Aircraft t/hour*blockh and t/cycle must be calibrated as additive decomposition; do not add cycle burn to an already complete total flight burn.
Fuel product + uplift + storage only if separately billed; exclude recoverable VAT from result but track gross VAT cash and recovery.
Deduction5824 includes excise2800 liability: net base benefit3024; gross and net presentations reconcile.
Airport turn charged once at actual airport using billing rules; origin/destination physical movements and landing/takeoff package not blindly duplicated.
Full passenger service versus reduced/no-baggage/transit packages are alternatives. Terminal and passenger service may be separate where tariff says so.
Historical aggregate pax500/650 cannot be added to itemised terminal+service+catering until overlap decomposed.
UFA receive/release is ground service, not a complete engine/airframe PBH reserve; verify scope before combining with MRO contract.
Airport basing133477/month in KHV is aerodrome service, not complete staff/crew/MRO base cost; parking/basing replacement verified by contract.
Once donor contribution is included in all-affected-business project-KEEP, no extra subtraction. Shadow alternative cost is memo, not another cash outflow.
Shared base, reserve, entry cost, support cap and common OD are evaluated once for combined programme, not sum of standalone variants.
Airframe advance offsets final purchase payment; deposit is asset/cash until expense or forfeiture. Capex and depreciation are different ledgers.
Airport rebate either reduces expense or is support credit once; charter guaranteed blocks replace corresponding inventory revenue, not added to it.

support_eligibility.three_valued_logic: true/false/null per test; null never becomes true; no-award sensitivity is separate from actual unknown
support_eligibility.regional_ordinary: Different subjects + eligible endpoint/listed hub + distance limit + previous traffic criterion + no overlapping federal route support + admissible calendar + selected operator/contract/volume/fare/budget
support_eligibility.seasonal_branch: Winter-only operations where p5z applies; not merely remove summer subsidy while retaining untested year-round supported programme
support_eligibility.year_round_branch: Requires proven Arctic/FE/remote or requested federal rate<=5%cap exception (and all other criteria) or independently validated applicable contract/rule
support_eligibility.p5z_status: INTERPRETATION_REQUIRES_VALIDATION; rule addresses route carriage, not only payment months; no prohibition of unsubsidised year-round service
support_eligibility.new_rule_or_contract: New pinned evidence version; do not silently substitute historic V7 for future award terms
support_eligibility.fuel: Qualifying received and uplifted fuel registry and excise position; model burnt tonnes only physical proxy; domestic-flight boolean is insufficient

cash_dates.ticket: Booking/payment, merchant/agent settlement, carriage revenue and refund separate; bookings beyond horizon retain liability
cash_dates.regional: Report<=15 next month -> decision<=10 days -> payment<=10 working days; returned report correction5 days/review5 days; use Russian workday calendar including holidays
cash_dates.fuel_tax: Actual filing/audit/offset/refund dates; no supported universal1/2/3month bank lag; tax offset is not bank cash
cash_dates.cost: Order/advance, service/invoice, supplier due and payment date; fixed minima survive cancellation if committed
cash_dates.end_of_horizon: Include terminal receivables/payables/deposits/refunds/lease return/penalties; do not recognise refunds or liquidate assets at arbitrary horizon
cash_dates.funding: Use event-level intra-month peak; month-end minimum can understate liquidity. Monthly reporting carries event extrema.
